summary: Executor of his father Thomas Lamoreaux's will, settled in Jackson Township, Luzerne County; John's 5th-great-grand-uncle.
bio: John Lamoreaux was born on 21 November 1780 in Monroe Township, Orange County, New York, a son of Thomas Lamoreaux. He settled in Jackson Township, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, and was named executor of his father's will; a codicil of 1826 reduced his own bequest to $50, 'considering... the privileges already he has had'. He died in Jackson Township in 1852, though one record gives 13 August 1853. He is John's 5th-great-grand-uncle.

researchNotes:
John Lamoreaux (1780-1852) of Jackson Twp, executor of his father's will; the 1826 codicil cut his bequest to $50 'considering... the privileges already he has had'.

FamilySearch gives John a birth date of 21 Nov 1780 at Monroe and a death date of 13 Aug 1853 in Jackson Twp, but a burial in 1852; the site has his death in 1852. It cites a Historical Society of Pennsylvania death card and his father's probate file ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch names Martha Ives as his wife, but she was Joshua's wife (see H0181), so that looks like a cross-attachment.
